children: Tecogen filed a Form S-3 to register 4,507,603 shares for resale and trust holders agreed to a 182-day lock-up.
Filed a Registration Statement on Form S-3 to cover reoffer and resale of 4,507,603 shares by selling stockholders.
All registered shares were originally acquired in private placement transactions exempt from SEC registration.
Trusts holding 3,475,714 shares entered lock-up agreements restricting transfers for 182 days after the S-3 is declared effective.
Lock-up permits limited transfers (to beneficiaries, court orders) provided transferees sign equivalent lock-up agreements.
Agreement allows establishment of 10b5-1 plans but prohibits sales under such plans during the lock-up period.
